test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My mother asked me, “Who is the new Mathematics teacher?”

options.text: My mother asked me who the new Mathematics teacher was.
My mother asked me who the new Mathematics teacher were.
My mother asked me who the new Mathematics teacher is.
My mother asked me who new the Mathematics teacher was.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In reported speech, the tense of the verb often changes, but the word order remains the same.
 
• The original question **"Who is the new Mathematics teacher?"** changes to **"who the new Mathematics teacher was" **in reported speech.
 
• The verb **"is"** changes to **"was"** to maintain grammatical consistency in reported speech.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'my mother asked me who the new mathematics teacher was.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) "My mother asked me who the new Mathematics teacher were." **- The verb "were" does not agree with the singular subject "the new Mathematics teacher."
 
• **Option 3) "My mother asked me who the new Mathematics teacher is."** - This maintains the tense of the original question but does not follow the grammatical structure of reported speech.
 
• **Option 4) "My mother asked me who new the Mathematics teacher was." **- The word order is incorrect; "new" should come after "the."
